name: DDLC: Coldest Summer
source:
Coldest Summer is an alternate universe setting where Sayori’s parents have died, and she ended up being adopted into MC’s family. As her depression escalates, she confides in him that she’s been fighting it all her life. Once the initial shock subsides, he needs to figure out how to help her hold out for at least a few days until he can get proper help for her. She’s already hurt herself–he doesn’t want to see her do something she can never take back. Can you help her avoid a terrible fate?

[Edited from [url=https://dokimods.me/mods/coldest-summer]DokiMods[/url]]
translation:
《最冷的夏天》是一个平行宇宙，纱世里的父母去世了，她最终被MC的家庭收养。随着她的抑郁症不断升级，她向他吐露自己一生都在与抑郁症作斗争。一旦最初的震惊消退，他需要弄清楚如何帮助她坚持至少几天，直到他能为她得到适当的帮助。她已经伤害了自己——他不想看到她做出永远无法挽回的事情。你能帮助她避免可怕的命运吗？

[编辑自[url=https://dokimods.me/mods/coldest-summer]DokiMods[/url]]
